 BeckerWorks It all will depend on how much you will use it. As with any marble surface it will
 require more care and maintenance than granite or quartz surfaces. Because it's much softer it
 will scratch easier - there's nothing you can do about it. It will also etch (if it's a polished finish)
 and definitely stain if you leave any spills for a prolonged time.
The best general care is to:
a. wipe any spills right away
b. don't place abrasive items on the tops - use mats and trivets instead
c. seal it every few months to prolong it's "new" look.
